Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern 100% Cotton Tufted Contrast Decorative Throw Pillow, 17" x 17", Black White
Colors: Black, White
Tufts of square Black yarn add a three-dimensional look and feel to this modern high-contrast pillow. A reverse side of solid Black gives you an alternative look, and the pillow can be thrown in the wash for convenient cleaning. 17" x 17" 100 % Cotton Polyester fiber-filled insert included Made in india Brush, vacuum or spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
